title: Stone2 솔로 #39 · super hourglass · 석재 turquoise · 도시 광장 · 코랄 립 극한
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a deep ebony-brown complexion, mid 50s goddess, super hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum beyond any proportion, most dramatic hourglass ratio ever recorded on any human body, thighs so thick pressing together, sleek slicked-back jet-black hair — full body polished turquoise fused directly to her own form wrapping her whole body from the collarbones to the ankles, both legs carved all the way down to the ankles — this is solid stone curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted stone sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, every section standing proud of the next. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING sky-blue turquoise surface across the full torso and both legs down to the ankles, VIVID dark brown matrix webbing running through every section, with tiny inlaid gemstones set along the joints, high-gloss polished, completely opaque, with a deep three-dimensional carved surface. Pose: standing with both arms relaxed at her sides, palms turned slightly forward, head tilted a little — most extreme super hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Cracks: the turquoise body shows weathering in only two places: one bold, clearly visible crack running across her left shoulder, and one chipped-off piece at her left thigh, where the broken edge reveals the dull raw pale chalky blue-grey stone with a rough surface, much duller than the polished outside inside. Everywhere else, including her bust, the turquoise is smooth, polished and whole, and her face, ears and neck are living skin.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, platform stiletto pumps in nude leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts, while her body keeps its full original proportions — thick heavy thighs, wide full hips and a huge bust exactly as massive as before, with her legs and ankles staying solid carved turquoise right down to the shoes.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, almond nails each longer than her middle finger, carved from the same turquoise with a high polish.
Jewelry: heavy gold rings on every finger, a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest, and thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face, ears and entire neck are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: pushed to the absolute extreme: neon-bright saturated orange-red lacquer-glossy lips overlined fuller than natural, bold golden-peach eyeshadow, dramatic lashes, a glowing warm blush. Her neck, from under the jaw down to the base of the neck, is bare real skin with visible pores and a soft natural sheen; the carved body starts exactly at the base of the neck, and her shoulders, chest, belly with its navel, arms, hands, wrists, legs and ankles are all carved turquoise.

Background: a sunny city plaza of light paving with a low fountain edge, a street lamp and standard-height shop doors behind her, clear daylight sky, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — carved material everywhere from the collarbones to the ankles. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
